Lakeside City census complete: {变量1} residents live along the lakeshore. Local housing, water services, workshops, and public depots remain under Lakeside's own management. The census establishes population figures; it does not create new residents.

The former clerks of Lakeside City's administration have reached retirement age. Two local adult residents have taken over their duties. Training materials for the handover are supplied by Lakeside's public depot, ensuring a smooth transition of local responsibilities and population records.

The two cities sign "{变量1}". They exchange only agreed-upon supplies and jointly protect trade routes. Their household registers, assets, and administrative responsibilities remain entirely independent.

The two cities halt new shipping orders. Cargo that has not yet arrived turns back with its original vehicles. Travel expenses already incurred are non-refundable. Both cities return to their own self-sufficient production schedules.
The two cities restore shipping authorization. Before departure, local minimum reserves, vehicle capacity, and road conditions must still be checked.

The limited agreement has ended. Cargo in transit is returned to each city's public depot according to the distance already traveled. Repaired roads remain in place, while both cities' inventories and resident registers remain untouched.

Future road maintenance and operating expenses will be shared under "{变量1}". Batches already in transit will still be settled under the previous agreement. Each city continues to cover its own drivers' travel rations.

Lakeside City's workshop expansion is complete. Local equipment production stations have increased from 80 to 160. Even if external shipments are interrupted, the city can now shoulder more of its own needs.
The highway connecting the two cities is complete. Limited cooperation can now be negotiated.

Hearth City and Lakeside City have established a cooperation network. Supplies are exchanged according to agreement, while public expenses are recorded separately by each city. This is a group of cities sharing limited responsibilities, not a unified nation. Each city retains its own public depots.
